title: Post-Exploitation and Command & Control
story: After the web application compromise, the SOC observed unusual process execution and recurring outbound connections from the banking server. Some traffic belongs to legitimate update services. Determine whether the attacker established persistence and identify the command-and-control infrastructure.
objective: Correlate Wazuh endpoint telemetry, Zeek DNS records, Zeek connection logs and process activity to identify persistence, malware activity and command-and-control communication.

questions.label: Identify the suspicious payload or malware name
Approximately how often does the compromised host beacon to the C2 server?
